name: ecommerce-gift-cards-and-store-credit
description: Balances a merchant owes, held as an append-only ledger and folded on every read — there is no balance column anybody can edit. A gift card code is a bearer credential: no column in this module can hold one in plain text, the full code is returned once at issue and never again, and every redemption failure answers identically so a guess never confirms a hit. Store credit is the same ledger with a different issue path. No default currency, and a redemption in another currency is refused rather than converted.

A keyed lookup index, so redemption is still one query
A per-row hash that survives a pepper leak
The full code returned once, at issue, and never again
Every redemption failure answers identically
A uniform-cost lookup, so timing confirms nothing either
Crockford base32, twenty characters, a hundred bits
Per-presenter rate limiting on the code path
